authorization: User requests Windows/IIS public deployment. Target origin, Windows/Linux connection details and audience are pending. Prepare target-independent staging tools now; do not invent a destination or publish a shared capability.
scope: Harden staged IIS installation and provide a bounded unauthenticated HTTPS probe. Preserve R6 application, SQL, sandbox, profile and workspace behavior. These tools support the existing private-operator shared-workspace profile only; public anonymous or isolated multiuser access requires a separate contract if selected.

installation.preflight: Before mutation, require elevated Windows PowerShell, dedicated new site/app pool, web root containing only rendered web.config, canonical lowercase DNS authority matching HTTPS/host/fixed loopback rewrite rules, required modules and exact ARR settings, no conflicting IIS/HTTP.sys binding, and LocalMachine/My certificate with private key and valid dates. Test-Certificate SSL policy checks DNS, trust chain and revocation without allowing untrusted roots; inability to validate fails closed. -PreflightOnly performs no IIS/config mutations; certificate revocation lookup may use network.
installation.staging: Create site with serverAutoStart=false before configuration commit; never invoke Start. Configure SNI HTTPS and certificate, dedicated no-managed-runtime app pool and conservative W3C log fields excluding URI query, username, cookies, Authorization, referrer and custom fields. A stage result is not public acceptance. Deployment assumes exclusive operator configuration window; concurrent administrator changes are outside automatic transaction guarantees.
installation.failure: Preflight failure changes nothing. On mutation failure, clean only invocation-created resources after verifying their expected identity; do not remove preexisting or uncertain resources. Preserve explicit failure and recovery instructions when cleanup cannot be established. No DNS, firewall, global ARR, SSH accounts/keys or service supervisor changes are performed automatically.
installation.exposure: Keep site stopped and public ingress restricted for staging. Explicit target operations after audience/target resolution must run native acceptance, then intentionally start/enable the site and adjust intended ingress. No default public start, shared token injection or launch-link publication. HTTP.sys certificate state, stopped site, logging, and effective inheritance require native Windows verification.

probe.input: Canonical HTTPS DNS origin only, no userinfo, query, fragment or path; optional explicit nondefault port. Never accept a real bearer or launch URL. Standard trusted TLS validation, no bypass, redirects, ambient HTTP proxy or cookie session.
probe.requests: Bounded sequential GETs against only configured authority with fixed paths and synthetic invalid credentials. Check root is Allow HTML, protected route rejects absent/invalid bearer, hostile Origin/Host/forwarded authority cannot grant access, and encoded/matrix aliases remain rejected. Check no-store/nosniff/no-referrer/CSP on successful root and canonical backend denials. Edge-level denial headers and authenticated normalized-path semantics remain separate native acceptance checks.
probe.bounds: Finite request list, explicit network timeout and response-body cap; body overflow, TLS/network/protocol error, redirects, wrong statuses or missing expected headers fail. Record only check identifiers, status, pass/fail, timing and fixed error category; never persist response bodies, headers or secrets. Nonzero exit on any failure.
probe.meaning: Probe success establishes only tested unauthenticated boundary checks. It cannot establish authenticated document behavior, per-user isolation, external firewall reachability, certificate renewal, logging absence, tunnel recovery or public-deployment acceptance. No request modifies application state.

evidence.before_code: Review this exact contract with two GPT-6.1 Terra, two GPT-6.1 Sol and two GPT-6 Astra seats; supplement Lean with finite exposure/staging, ownership-safe cleanup and probe-evidence predicates, positive witnesses and negative obligations. Compile twice in fresh directories and record theorem/axiom and hash evidence before production edits.
evidence.tests: Exercise probe against deterministic local HTTP/TLS fixtures including hostile responses, redirects, TLS failures, size/time limits and redacted evidence. Validate PowerShell syntax and mocked staging/failure branches when a PowerShell runtime can be obtained; mark native Windows execution OPEN. Preserve existing deploy tests. Repackage exact unchanged application builds with changed deployment sources and audited manifest; no live stores/credentials or user preview touched.
evidence.limits: Finite Lean policy proofs do not establish implementation refinement, IIS/HTTP.sys atomicity, TLS, cryptography, OS ACLs, revocation network availability, licensing, production performance or deployment acceptance. Windows target, audience and operational evidence are required separately. Public hosting and public redistribution are distinct; retain dependency notices and unresolved commercial/artifact redistribution gates.

target_acceptance: Named origin, Windows/Linux access and audience resolved; private shared capability profile explicitly accepted or new access architecture implemented.
Native certificate/SNI/HTTPS and exact proxy Host/Origin/Authorization behavior, URI normalization and duplicate-header rejection; effective logs exclude secrets and error headers reviewed.
Authenticated create/validate/save/history/solver and canonical server%3AUUID paths; old capability invalid after restart, retained documents survive.
Restricted SSH identity/known-host ACLs, loopback-only listeners, private backend/firewall, reviewed tunnel supervisor and restart/reboot/outage recovery.
External no-bearer probe and browser flow, 4vCPU/8GiB resource/latency measurement, backup/recovery and certificate renewal procedure. Record incomplete checks honestly.
